svg.font-family: 'Plex Mono Sub', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.text: one question per word, one probability back, one threshold
for every word, Jev is asked:
In "<a few words around it, the word in [brackets]>", what is the bracketed word?
NONE · PERSON · LOCATION · CONTACT · ID · DATETIME · OTHER
over-masked: the annotators left this in clear
Jev reads the document once per call and answers every question with probabilities. No text is generated.
